Tang du lieu (lib/*.ts, lib/account/, lib/api/) KHONG duoc import @comitor/ui. Keo goi giao dien vao day la keo ca React theo, va khi do createTask/seed/job nen khong chay duoc bang tsx nua (SyntaxError: react does not provide useLayoutEffect). Hang dung chung ma ca giao dien lan may chu can thi de o lib/core/. Xem docs/kien-truc-ung-dung.md muc 2, hang D.

Tang du lieu KHONG duoc import tinh next/navigation, next/link, next/image. Chung keo theo runtime client cua React, va khi do lib/ khong nap duoc bang tsx nua — pnpm seed, job nen va script bao tri deu chet theo (da gap that: SyntaxError react does not provide useLayoutEffect). Can mot helper cua Next thi dung import() DONG trong chinh ham can no — xem requireReadPermission. next/headers va next/server thi KHONG bi cam: chung chi chay o may chu. Xem docs muc 2, hang D.
